# Candidate Assessment: DOC_resume_ninety against DOC_posting_ten_five

## Mandatory Requirements

| # | Requirement | Candidate | Match |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Python | Languages: Python | ✅ |
| 2 | SQL | Languages: SQL | ✅ |
| 3 | Linux administration | Platform: Linux administration | ✅ |
| 4 | Git | Platform: Git | ✅ |
| 5 | REST API design | Services: REST API design | ✅ |
| 6 | Unit testing | Services: unit testing | ✅ |
| 7 | CI pipelines | Services: CI pipelines | ✅ |
| 8 | Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, Helm | Infrastructure: all five listed | ✅ |
| 9 | Kafka | Streaming: Kafka | ✅ |
| 10 | GraphQL | Not listed | ❌ |

**Mandatory match: 9 of 10 = 90%**

Item 8 bundles five tools under one number. Counting each tool separately gives 13 of 14, or about 92.9%. Either way the candidate clears the threshold, so the outcome is the same.

## Nice-to-Have (does not affect the outcome)

Grafana, Prometheus, technical writing, mentoring, and public speaking: **none appear on the résumé (0 of 5).**

## Result

**90% mandatory match, which meets the 85% threshold. Proceed.**

The only mandatory gap is **GraphQL**. It would be worth asking about in interview, since the candidate's REST API design background may transfer.
